name: Thevisuplate
vision: To become the most modern digital identity platform where users can showcase everything—images, videos, QR-linked content, portfolios, business cards, and more.
problem: Traditional portfolios and digital business cards are static, limited, and not visually engaging. Thevisuplate solves this by turning your identity into an interactive digital plate.
achievements: Reached first set of active users
customer_impact: Helps individuals present their identity, skills, and digital content in a modern and visually engaging format.

name: Milzull
vision: To build a trusted social and real-world interaction platform where people can connect, share, offer services, and grow communities beyond traditional social media.
problem: Existing social platforms are either entertainment-focused or transactional, lacking genuine local interaction and trust. Milzull solves this by combining social content, services, and real-world connections in one platform.
features: Social posts with images, videos, and text
Service discovery and local offerings (Milzull Services)
achievements: Built real-time posts, chat, and notifications
customer_impact: Helps users connect socially, discover services, and build trust-based relationships in a single platform designed for real-world relevance.
